About ServiceBay

Property maintenance in Dubai, from first call to handover.

We help Dubai homeowners, landlords and businesses look after their buildings. Our aim is simple. When we leave, you should know what changed and how to care for it.

Meet our team

Our philosophy

Understand the property first.

A leak in a family kitchen and a leak on a shop floor can need the same repair. When and how we carry it out matters just as much. We start by asking who uses the space and what needs to keep running.

Our mission
Make repairs straightforward to arrange. Explain what needs attention, agree the price and leave the customer with a clear account of the work.
Our vision
Help property owners plan maintenance around the life of their building, from the first service visit to the next scheduled check.

Our service approach

What to expect on a job

A scope you can review
We ask about the property, access and the work required before preparing a quote.
A visit that suits the site
We agree when someone can attend, which rooms need access and how to keep disruption to a minimum.
A clear handover
We explain what was repaired, what to keep an eye on and when a follow-up would help.

Our values

What you can expect from us

Reliability

We agree the scope, arrival window and access arrangements with you before the visit.

Respect

We ask about occupied rooms, quiet hours and site rules before we start.

Integrity

If an inspection uncovers extra work, we explain the options and ask for approval.

Workmanship

At handover, we walk through the repair and explain how to look after it.

People behind the work

Our Team

A good repair gives someone their day back. That’s the standard we aim for, from the first call to the last check.

Service coordination
Your first point of contact for access instructions, appointment times and questions after a visit.
Trade technicians
The people who inspect the fault, explain the repair and check the work with you at handover.
Maintenance planning
For ongoing cover, the team helps you list the equipment, agree a visit schedule and review the proposal.
Contact the team

Service information

Before you book a technician

Dispatch and response

We arrange visits at customers’ properties in Dubai. Call 056 201 4647 Monday to Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM Dubai time, to discuss urgency and the next available team.

See our Dubai service areas

Scope and aftercare

Ask which technician will handle the job and what the quoted work includes. Before approving a repair, ask for parts and workmanship warranty terms in writing. Keep your quote reference for follow-up.

How we work

Follow your service visit

See what happens at each stage, from your first message to follow-up.

Assessment

Tell us what needs attention.

Share the property type, area and a short description. Photos can help us understand the issue before the visit.

What you get

An initial assessment of the issue

Quotation

See the scope and pricing together.

We outline the work and share a quote. If the scope depends on an inspection, we explain what we need to check.

What you get

A quote you can review

Approval

Choose when the work goes ahead.

Once you approve the scope, we agree on the visit time and confirm any property access instructions.

What you get

Agreed work and visit details

Execution

A technician carries out the agreed work.

If we find something outside the agreed scope, we discuss it with you before proceeding.

What you get

Work carried out to the agreed scope

Handover

Walk through the completed work.

We show you what was done and explain relevant checks or any follow-up the property needs.

What you get

A work summary and any next steps

Aftercare

Get help after the visit.

Contact us with questions about the completed job. We can review what has changed and discuss the next step.

What you get

A follow-up with our team
